answer: Have each agent bind its signing key to a scarce, nontransferable stake, then require a randomly selected committee of distinct stake-backed identities to approve high-value actions. Sybils can still be created, but splitting one stake among many keys does not increase voting weight; gaining influence means acquiring more stake, which can be slashed for provable double-signing. The garden of identities stays costly to counterfeit, while a gale of fake accounts buys an attacker little without risking real capital. A fable of effortless identities is no substitute for that bond.
